item.title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
item.dc:creator: Theresa Loconsolo, Anthony Ha
item.description: Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the majority voted to impose more restrictions on data center development. And even when data centers weren’t on the ballot directly, they were a […]

item.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to help 6K scale up its microwave-plasma battery material manufacturing process.

item.title: Fox completes its $22B acquisition of Roku
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: A few months after DOJ investigators were probing the deal, Fox just completed its $22B acquisition of the streaming giant Roku.

item.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.

item.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

item.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

item.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

item.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.

item.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

item.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

item.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.

item.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

item.title: Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Serve Robotics announced alonsgside its third-quarter earnings that it will launch a new business line called Physical AI Services to offer customers its connectivity and data tools.

item.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

item.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

item.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

item.title: US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: A joint U.S. government statement says the hacks are affecting the food, transportation, and healthcare industries after reports of global mass hacks.

item.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

item.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.
